test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘**DALLAS**' is written as ‘**EAMLBS**’ and ‘**PRAGUE**’ is written as ‘**QRBGVE**’. How will ‘**BERLIN** ' be written in that language?
solution:
‘DALLAS' = ‘EAMLBS’ 

‘PRAGUE’ = ‘QRBGVE’.

‘BERLIN' =** '?'**

Here,** 2nd, 4th and last letters are same **where as **1st, 3rd, and 5th letter is changed by successor** of the given alphabets in the alphabetical series

 ‘DALLAS' is written as ‘EAMLBS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34295ad52696fac337631f1c4ce30405c768e9cadd3092470c5cee9c51bf3fa6.png] 

 ‘PRAGUE’ is written as ‘QRBGVE’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f44c7841d4e60628aed9c36dfede7ff86ec240f0d3fbeaac3608432edbaa80a9.png] 

‘BERLIN' = '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e1286bfdc0c95b87079e2e2bd3c0e652f02c34c42539503bb48af8023305ba2.png] 

**'?'** will be replaced by **'CESLJN'**

Hence, the correct answer is** option(2)**. 'CESLJN'
